draft.title: Vitamins
card: Vitamins are nutrients the body needs in small amounts to work well. Each vitamin has its own jobs.
helps wounds heal. Fruits such as oranges and vegetables such as capsicum are good sources.
helps the body take in calcium for bone growth. Skin makes it when exposed to sunlight, and some foods such as eggs and oily fish also give it.
is needed for a healthy pregnancy. Green leafy vegetables and legumes are good sources.
draft.remember: Vitamins are needed in small amounts, and each one has its own job.

a.q: Which vitamin helps a cut on the skin to heal?
a.why: Vitamin C is the vitamin linked to wound healing. Vitamin D is tempting because it is linked to the body's growth, but its job is to help bones by helping the body take in calcium.

b.q: A doctor tells Mei, who is planning a pregnancy, to eat more green leafy vegetables and legumes. Which vitamin is the doctor mainly thinking of?
b.why: Folate is needed for a healthy pregnancy, and green leafy vegetables and legumes are good sources. Vitamin C is found in some vegetables too, but its job on the card is healing, not pregnancy.
b.clue: Which vitamin is linked to pregnancy?
